description:
Update an existing project's settings.

WHEN TO USE:
- Rename a project
- Change project color, view mode, or type
- Reorder projects in the list

PARTIAL UPDATE: Only provide fields you want to change. Unspecified fields remain unchanged.

REQUIRED: projectId

OPTIONAL (at least one required):
- name: New project name
- color: New hex color (e.g., '#F18181')
- viewMode: 'list', 'kanban', or 'timeline'
- kind: 'TASK' or 'NOTE'
- sortOrder: New position in project list

color.description: New project color in hex format (e.g., '#F18181'). Optional.

projectId.description: The unique ID of the project to update (required)

name: update_project
title: Update Project
